rationale: Both Saurabh and Abdul are deeply focused on AI agents and LLM tooling—Saurabh has shipped AI agent projects and early-stage agentic tooling at HiJenny AI, while Abdul is founding around AI agents and LLM tooling at Baseline Labs with conviction on agent observability for stateful systems. They share Python, TypeScript, and JavaScript, and their complementary roles (AI Engineer + Founding Engineer) create a natural technical sounding board, especially as Abdul scales hard problems in agent architecture.
intro_message: Saurabh Khire, meet Abdul Rahim Mirani — you're both building in AI agents and LLM tooling and could compare approaches on making agents more observable and reliable at scale.
